name: Ava AI
task: AI voice agents that answer for you
summary: AI phone agent for Shopify stores: answers support calls 24/7 (order lookup, edits and refunds mid-call) and runs outbound abandoned-cart recovery calls, with recordings, transcripts and its own business number. Priced by call minutes.
best_for: Shopify DTC and cash-on-delivery stores with real inbound call volume that want 24/7 phone support and outbound cart-recovery automated, and are comfortable with per-minute economics
skip_if: low-call-volume or thin-margin stores where per-minute overage can dwarf the base fee, and anyone who needs a proven track record: the review base is tiny (six) and the app is under a year old
honest_knock: The monthly price is a minutes allowance, not a flat fee: every minute past the bucket bills at $0.07 to $0.10, so a busy support line can cost far more than the headline. And keep the vendor's marketing at arm's length: Ava launched in September 2025 with just six App Store reviews, and the promoted 21–24x ROAS figures are the vendor's own, not independently verified. There is no free plan, only a 7-day trial.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, includes 100 call minutes, then $0.10 a minute overage
pricing.notes: (verified 2026-10-16 on apps.shopify.com/ava-ai and avasales.ai) Three paid tiers, no free plan, each with a 7-day trial. Support is $29 a month and includes 100 call minutes, then $0.10 a minute; Recover is $99 a month with 400 minutes and $0.08 over; Scale is $499 a month with 1,500 minutes and $0.07 over. The headline price is really a minutes bucket: a store with real call volume pays the overage, so cost tracks conversation length, not seats. Estimate your monthly call minutes before you compare — at heavy volume the effective bill can sit well above the tier price.

source_quotes.quote: Scale $499 / month $499/mo: $0.07 per minute after 1500 included minutes monthly
Support $29 / month $29/mo: $0.10 per minute after 100 included minutes monthly
Recover $99 / month $0.08 per minute after 400 included minutes monthly
Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial.

compare_with.name: Ringly.io
compare_with.why: Ringly and Ava both put an AI voice agent on a Shopify store's phone line; Ava leans into live order actions and outbound recovery with per-minute pricing, while alternatives like Ringly, CallFlows and Fin differ mainly on minute rates and how much they do beyond answering. Compare on expected call minutes, not sticker price

claims.claim: We're provisioning your AI agent's phone number

claims.plan: Entry plan approval screen, cancelled, development store

claims.buying_consequence: The test says nothing about whether the phone agent answers calls or sounds realistic.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Ava AI on a Shopify development store, but the core action was blocked because no plan was approved: the Shopify approval screen had the test charge sentence and also an Add payment method row. Only the install permissions, the plans, the approval screen, the page Phone numbers and agents without a plan (a number stuck on Setting up) and the uninstall dialog were seen, after which the app was uninstalled. No call was made and nothing was paid. Install: the install form on the App Store listing opened in our own tab; the dialog Install app asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data and was approved. The start was at about 15:58 (Dutch time) and the app was installed at about 15:59 after Install app. The app opened straight on Plans and pricing, with the notice Setting up your phone number, which says the phone number of the AI agent is being provisioned. No account on the vendor site, password, demo, call or card was asked at install. The App Store listing then showed 5.0 stars and 7 reviews, where the dossier has 6 reviews and 4.7. Core action NOT DONE: the core of the app is an AI agent that answers a phone call. No plan was approved, so there was no working phone number and no call was made. Without a plan the button Turn on still opened the page Phone numbers and agents with 0 numbers, 0 agents active and 1 off, the text Setting up number, the agent Main Agent (inbound), the red text Phone number does not match shop numbers followed by nothing, and the notice Agent limit reached (all 1 inbound agent of the plan is in use). The tabs were Inbound and Outbound. The number stayed on Setting up for about 2 minutes. No agent was enabled, no call was answered and no time to a first result could be measured. Plans: the app shows three plans with a Start free trial button each. The entry plan is $29 a month with 100 minutes included, $0.10 per additional minute and 1 call at a time. The middle plan is $99 with 400 minutes, $0.08 per additional minute, 3 simultaneous calls, outbound abandoned-cart calling and a custom voice. The top plan is $499 with 1,500 minutes, $0.07 per additional minute, unlimited simultaneous calls, multiple phone numbers and priority support. Under the cards: All plans: 7 day free trial. No long-term contract. Cancel anytime. The prices and minutes agree with the App Store listing and the dossier; the number of simultaneous calls per plan (1, 3, unlimited) is new compared with the listing. Checkout: Start free trial was clicked for the entry plan. The Shopify screen Approve subscription showed the notice You will not be billed for this test charge, the message that the app bills a recurring subscription and usage charges, the plan at $29,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov, a subtotal of $29,00 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $29,00 due 24 Nov, a note that the subtotal contains only the subscription fee and that usage is charged on top, which is variable, and an App spending limit of a maximum of $200,00 USD per 30 days. The screen also had an Add payment method row, so although it carried the test charge sentence we did not approve it; no card was entered. Cancel was clicked; the screen said Charge declined and returned to the list of apps. Cancelling: no subscription ran, so nothing could be cancelled. The uninstall dialog (Settings, Apps, menu, Uninstall) says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required (Testing multiple apps was chosen). The app was uninstalled on 17 November and left the installed list. Not tested: the core action, a working phone number, enabling the agent, a phone call, outbound cart recovery calls, Call Logs, Integrations, Advanced, the amount at the end of the trial and the real minutes used. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no subscription was approved, no payment method was entered and no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Nothing works before a plan is approved, yet the page Phone numbers and agents opens anyway with a number stuck on Setting up for about 2 minutes, an agent marked as not matching shop numbers with no number named and a notice that the agent limit is reached; the approval screen had the test charge sentence and an Add payment method row, so it was not approved; after Cancel the screen said Charge declined; the spending limit of $200,00 per 30 days is not in the listing; the App Store listing showed 7 reviews and 5.0 stars against 6 and 4.7 in the dossier.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Ava AI on a Shopify development store, but the core action was blocked because no plan was approved: the Shopify approval screen had the test charge sentence and also an Add payment method row. Only the install permissions, the plans, the approval screen, the page Phone numbers and agents without a plan (a number stuck on Setting up) and the uninstall dialog were seen, after which the app was uninstalled. No call was made and nothing was paid. Install: the install form on the App Store listing opened in our own tab; the dialog Install app asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data and was approved. The start was at about 15:58 (Dutch time) and the app was installed at about 15:59 after Install app. The app opened straight on Plans and pricing, with the notice Setting up your phone number, which says the phone number of the AI agent is being provisioned. No account on the vendor site, password, demo, call or card was asked at install. The App Store listing then showed 5.0 stars and 7 reviews, where the dossier has 6 reviews and 4.7. Core action NOT DONE: the core of the app is an AI agent that answers a phone call. No plan was approved, so there was no working phone number and no call was made. Without a plan the button Turn on still opened the page Phone numbers and agents with 0 numbers, 0 agents active and 1 off, the text Setting up number, the agent Main Agent (inbound), the red text Phone number does not match shop numbers followed by nothing, and the notice Agent limit reached (all 1 inbound agent of the plan is in use). The tabs were Inbound and Outbound. The number stayed on Setting up for about 2 minutes. No agent was enabled, no call was answered and no time to a first result could be measured. Plans: the app shows three plans with a Start free trial button each. The entry plan is $29 a month with 100 minutes included, $0.10 per additional minute and 1 call at a time. The middle plan is $99 with 400 minutes, $0.08 per additional minute, 3 simultaneous calls, outbound abandoned-cart calling and a custom voice. The top plan is $499 with 1,500 minutes, $0.07 per additional minute, unlimited simultaneous calls, multiple phone numbers and priority support. Under the cards: All plans: 7 day free trial. No long-term contract. Cancel anytime. The prices and minutes agree with the App Store listing and the dossier; the number of simultaneous calls per plan (1, 3, unlimited) is new compared with the listing. Checkout: Start free trial was clicked for the entry plan. The Shopify screen Approve subscription showed the notice You will not be billed for this test charge, the message that the app bills a recurring subscription and usage charges, the plan at $29,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov, a subtotal of $29,00 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $29,00 due 24 Nov, a note that the subtotal contains only the subscription fee and that usage is charged on top, which is variable, and an App spending limit of a maximum of $200,00 USD per 30 days. The screen also had an Add payment method row, so although it carried the test charge sentence we did not approve it; no card was entered. Cancel was clicked; the screen said Charge declined and returned to the list of apps. Cancelling: no subscription ran, so nothing could be cancelled. The uninstall dialog (Settings, Apps, menu, Uninstall) says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required (Testing multiple apps was chosen). The app was uninstalled on 17 November and left the installed list. Not tested: the core action, a working phone number, enabling the agent, a phone call, outbound cart recovery calls, Call Logs, Integrations, Advanced, the amount at the end of the trial and the real minutes used. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no subscription was approved, no payment method was entered and no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Nothing works before a plan is approved, yet the page Phone numbers and agents opens anyway with a number stuck on Setting up for about 2 minutes, an agent marked as not matching shop numbers with no number named and a notice that the agent limit is reached; the approval screen had the test charge sentence and an Add payment method row, so it was not approved; after Cancel the screen said Charge declined; the spending limit of $200,00 per 30 days is not in the listing; the App Store listing showed 7 reviews and 5.0 stars against 6 and 4.7 in the dossier.
